# `oaap node`

this node: profiles (RFC-0011) and host care (oaap.core.host).

**Root:** depends on the action -- see the table below.

## Usage

```sh
oaap node [--reason CARE_REASON] [--until CARE_UNTIL]
                 [--critical] [--read]
                 {show,add-profile,remove-profile,care} [profile] [rest ...]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | what to do -- see Actions below |
| `profile` | node profile, e.g. dev (RFC-0011); for 'care': measure \| sample \| auto-updates \| reboot-window |
| `rest` | care auto-updates on \| care reboot-window HH:MM\|off \| care reboot at <time>\|cancel \| care protect\|release <inst> |
| `--reason CARE_REASON` | for care reboot/protect: why, in words every tenant can read |
| `--until CARE_UNTIL` | for care protect: the last day (YYYY-MM-DD, default 7 days) |
| `--critical` | for care reboot at: urgency critical (overrides protections) |
| `--read` | for care advisories \| images: read now, not only when due |

## Actions

Whether an action needs `sudo` is read from the rule the node enforces, with the other arguments left out (e.g. `node care` reads, `node care measure` needs `sudo`).

| Action | Needs `sudo` |
|---|---|
| `show` | no |
| `add-profile` | yes |
| `remove-profile` | yes |
| `care` | no |
